### 99.4 Lane C: void, warp, spells cast this turn, cost reductions, graveyard / exile / library / hand (branch `eoe-c-void`)

**Void.** Void is the set's ability word for "if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn
or a spell was warped this turn". `Game::void_turn` holds the number of the last turn in which
either happened (no reset needed: void holds while it equals the turn number,
`Game::void_active`). It is set in `move_card` when a nonland permanent (its types as it last
existed on the battlefield) leaves the battlefield (not the "it never entered" move of Containment
Priest's replacement, `quiet_leave`), and in `cast_done` when a spell becomes cast (CR 601.2i) for
its warp cost (`AltCost::warp`, CR 702.185a): a warped spell that is countered still made void.
`Cond::Void` reads it; the lowering maps `TriggeredAbility.requires_void` to an intervening "if"
(`TrigPred::If(Cond::Void)`, CR 603.4), `ConditionalIfVoid` to a jump (one target described in both
branches is one target, as `IfConditionElse`), `StatePredicate:VoidActive` to an intervening "if",
`SacrificeSelfUnlessVoidActive` to "jump unless void, else sacrifice the source", and
`CostReduction.condition(VoidActiveCondition)` to `Discount::If(Cond::Void, n)`.

**The encoding gate.** Void is public state the layout v5 encoding cannot see (layout v5 is frozen;
no layout change here). `public_state.rs` classifies `Game.void_turn` public, perturbs it, and lists
it as the second "next layout" gap (`limits()`); `tests/az.rs::public_state_reaches_the_encoding`
now expects two gaps (the graveyard's order and void). The gate's view (`Game::view_of`) includes
it. A network has to infer void from the board until the next layout encodes it.

**Spells cast this turn and cost reductions** (CR 601.2f: the cost is determined before the spell
becomes cast, 601.2i, so the spells cast so far are the others). `Discount::If(Cond, n)`: "if you've
cast another spell this turn" (`Cond::SpellsCastAtLeast(1)`), "if your opponents control n or more
<permanents>" (`Cond::OpponentsControlAtLeast`), "during your turn", "if you control a
<permanent>", "if you attacked with a <subtype> this turn" (`Cond::AttackedWithSubtype`, the
attackers declared this turn by their cards' subtypes). "This spell costs {1} less to cast if it targets a blocking creature" (Dark Endurance:
`Discount::IfTargets`, `Filter::Blocking`): the targets are chosen before the cost is determined
(CR 601.2c, 601.2f), so `cost_with` reads the spell's chosen targets (`Game::target_discount`);
castability counts the reduced cost when a legal target matches (`target_discount_castable`, with
the card on the stack), and `choose_targets` offers only the targets with which the cost can still
be paid (a cast is offered only if it can be completed). `CardDef::casting` (`CastingRules`) holds
what a permanent does to its controller's spells: `spell_discounts`, "the second spell you cast
each turn costs {2} less" (`Cond::SpellsCastThisTurn { n: 1 }`) and "spells you cast have affinity
for artifacts" (`Discount::PerControlled`, CR 702.41a), applied in `Game::cost_with` after the
spell's own reductions. `Condition:AtLeastNSpellsCastThisTurn` is `Cond::SpellsCastAtLeast(n)` (a
static's "as long as you've cast two or more spells this turn").

**Effects** (`lower/eoe_c.rs`; the new instructions are `Ext::EoeC(EoeC)`, `engine/src/eoe_c.rs`):
each opponent discards / mills / discards or loses life (who can't discard has no card in hand),
exile target creature (as its target spec says), exile target creature with power or toughness n
or less, exile target creature until the source leaves (a linked exile, CR 610.3), exile all
graveyards (`EoeC::ExileAllGraveyards`, one instruction), put target card from a graveyard on the
bottom of its owner's library (`EoeC::GraveyardCardToBottom`, CR 401.4), look at the top n and put
one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard, Starwinder's "you may draw that many cards"
(the class is that ability: its Python docstring says the "may" is only simplified away there),
shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, draw a card per multicolored permanent
(`Amount::MulticoloredPermanents`, CR 105.2a), "mills cards equal to your life total"
(`Amount::ControllerLife`), "return target creature or Spacecraft card" (`or_spacecraft`, a
Spacecraft is an artifact subtype), and Cosmogoyf's P/T (`PtCda::OwnedInExile`: cards its
controller owns in exile, face up or down, not tokens).

**Casting rules** (`CastingRules`). "Each player can't cast more than one noncreature spell each
turn" (Deafening Silence): `Game::noncreature_spell_locked`, checked first in `cast_timing_ok`,
which every castability check passes through (from hand, from other zones, a face, a cast during a
resolution), with the face the card would be cast as. "The first spell each player casts during
each of their turns may be cast without paying its mana cost" (Weftwalking): an alternative cost
(CR 118.9) offered by `ChooseAltCost` as the last `NUMBER` (`eoe_c::FREE_FIRST_SPELL`; no layout
change) when the caster is the active player, has cast no spell this turn and casts the way that
allows an alternative cost (118.9a, `alt_allowed`); chosen, the spell's `from` becomes
`CastFrom::Permission { free: true }` (cost increases still apply, X is 0), the encoding's existing
"free" flag. Castability counts it (`hand_castable`, `castable_via`).

**Warp variants** (CR 702.185a). "Warp-{B}, Pay 2 life" (`warp_additional_life_cost`: the warp
`AltCost` pays life too, CR 119.4). "You may cast this card from your graveyard using its warp
ability" (`CastingRules::warp_from_graveyard`): a graveyard route (`route::WARP`, unless Yawgmoth's
Will's route, which allows the warp cost through `alt_allowed`, is there) cast as
`CastFrom::Permission`; `Game::warp_only` says a cast is that route's (no other permission), and
then castability needs the warp cost (not the mana cost) and the spell is cast for it with no
choice (`begin_cast_face` sets its alternative cost); `warp_from_graveyard_ok` lets warp's cost be
paid from a graveyard (`alt_payable`). The warped permanent is exiled at the next end step and may
be cast from exile on a later turn, as warp from hand. "Warp {X}{G}" on an {X} card (Broodguard
Elite, on a custom card): the warp cost's {X} must be the mana cost's, since the X announced adds
to any cost of the spell (`total_mana`). A graveyard warp cast is never "without paying its mana
cost" too (CR 118.9a: one alternative cost; found by the EoE fuzz, seed 752).

**More effects.** "Draw X cards, where X is the number of differently named lands you control"
(`Amount::DifferentlyNamedLands`, CR 201.2); "exile the top X cards of your library, where X is one
plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value; you may play them this turn" (`EoeC::ExileTopPlayThisTurn`
with `Amount::CostMvPlus`); "each opponent exiles a card from their hand and may play it for as long
as it remains exiled; each spell cast this way costs {1} more; each land played this way enters
tapped" (`EoeC::ExileFromOwnHandPlayable`, the opponent's choice among their own hand, one option
per definition; `PermKind::TaxedLandsTapped`, read by `play_land`).

**Lane C features of cross-lane cards** (tested on custom cards; the cards wait for the other
lanes): "exile target attacking creature an opponent controls; at the beginning of the next end
step, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control" (Mystifying Maze:
`Ext::ExileThenDelay` with `EoeC::ReturnEventCardTapped`); an "exile this permanent" activation
cost on the battlefield (Plaza of Heroes: the existing exile-self payment, now allowed there);
"search your library for a Sliver card" (Sliver Overlord); "whenever an opponent discards a card"
(Entropic Battlecruiser: the IR's `discards_card` event has one subject, the discarding player, so
its default subject is the engine event's player slot).

**IR defects** (docs/ir_defects.md 60-66, `lower::IR_DEFECTS`): All-Fates Stalker ("up to one
target" dropped), Endless Sands (a linked exile read as "until this leaves", its return an empty
effect), Gravkill and Archenemy's Charm (the target's "or Spacecraft" / "or planeswalker" dropped),
Elegy Acolyte ("one or more ... deal combat damage" as once per turn, as entry 16), Nexus of Fate
(its "from anywhere" replacement without the `watched_in_graveyard` flag), Pinnacle Starcage (the
Robot token by name only, as entry 3), Starfield Vocalist (its replacement's two event subjects
dropped: the IR is Strionic Resonator's), Mirrorpool (its {C} activation pips read as generic and
its mana ability dropped, as entry 5).

**Not done, and why.** Blade of the Swarm ("put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its
owner's library"): no action slot names an exiled card as a target (`Game::target_action` has no
exile range), so it needs a layout change; blocked. Full Bore ("if that creature was cast for its
warp cost, it also gains trample and haste"): a per-permanent fact layout v5 cannot encode (it
would be a third next-layout gap beside void); blocked by
`PumpTargetCreatureUntilEOT.granted_keywords_if_warp_cast`. Tannuk, Steadfast Second ("artifact
cards and red creature cards in your hand have warp {2}{R}"): an alternative cost a card has from
another permanent, which the engine has no place for (`StackItem::alt` indexes the card's own
`alt_costs`, and the warped permanent's end-step exile is the card's own delayed ability); blocked
by `CardPrinting.hand_ability_grants`. Lane C features of cross-lane cards not built:
`ReanimateTargetCreatureCardFromDefendersGraveyard` (Chorale of the Void),
`AlpharaelDreamingAcolyteDiscardEffect`, `CardPrinting.ward_discard_random`,
`EachOpponentExilesOwnCreature` and `SacrificeSelfPreservingExileLink` (Sothera, whose IR also puts
the sacrifice after the return), `ReturnUpToNCreaturesFromYourGraveyardToHand` (Archenemy's Charm,
an IR defect), Mirrorpool's two copy effects and Pinnacle Starcage's exile classes (IR defects).

**Results.** EoE support 93 -> 124: 31 lane C cards (All-Fates Scroll, Brightspear Zealot, Chrome
Companion, Codecracker Hound, Cosmogoyf, Dark Endurance, Deafening Silence, Decode Transmissions,
Gigastorm Titan, Hymn of the Faller, Illvoi Infiltrator, Insatiable Skittermaw, Interceptor Mechan,
Kavaron Skywarden, Lashwhip Predator, Lightstall Inquisitor, Memorial Vault, Plasma Bolt, Sami,
Wildcat Captain, Scavenger Grounds, Seedship Broodtender, Space-Time Anomaly, Starwinder, Temporal
Intervention, Timeline Culler, Tragic Trajectory, Uthros Psionicist, Virus Beetle, Voidforged Titan,
Warping Wail, Weftwalking; `SUPPORTED_EOE_C`).

**Tests.** `engine/tests/cards_eoe_c.rs` (the cards, and lane C features whose real cards need
another lane, on custom cards in `engine/tests/eoe_c_util`, the EoE table plus those cards).
Behaviour digests unchanged (`f6543eb2b1b8752f`); cube support 546 / 546. At 7fd4227: the full
engine suite 1,567 passed, 0 failed (15 ignored); `FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed (20,000
games, 433 s); the cube's `FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed (20,000 games and 1,000 matches, 412 s).

### 99.5 Lane D: creatures, combat, removal, damage, life, tokens, pumps (branch `eoe-d-combat`)

**Result.** 36 of the lane's 44 cards supported (`SUPPORTED_EOE_D`), the EoE table 93 -> 129 of 320
on this branch alone; 3 IR defects recorded (docs/ir_defects.md 80-82); 14 cross-lane features done
and tested on custom IR cards. Cube support 546 / 546 and the behaviour digests unchanged
(`f6543eb2b1b8752f`). Tests: `engine/tests/cards_eoe_d.rs` (53; its card table is `CardDb::eoe()`'s
cards plus vanilla test cards written as IR in the file: never `tests/common`, whose cards the cube's
fuzz pool and digests take).

**Supported (36).** Anticausal Vestige, Biosynthic Burst, Comet Crawler, Command Bridge, Cut
Propulsion, Darkness, Dawnstrike Vanguard, Depressurize, Devastating Onslaught, Diplomatic Relations,
Exosuit Savior, Faller's Faithful, Flight-Deck Coordinator, Focus Fire, Frontline War-Rager, Genemorph
Imago, Haliya Guided by Light, Hemosymbic Mite, Kavaron Harrier, Mechanozoa, Memorial Team Leader, Mightform Harmonizer,
Monoist Circuit-Feeder, Mouth of the Storm, Mutinous Massacre, Nova Hellkite, Perigee Beckoner, Sami
Ship's Engineer, Singularity Rupture, Skystinger, Swarm Culler, Systems Override, The Endstone,
Vaultguard Trooper, Zealous Display, Zero Point Ballad.

**How.** The lowering is `engine/src/lower/effect_eoe_d.rs` (a link in `lower_effect`'s chain), the
new instructions `Ext::EoeD(EoeD)` (`program.rs`) run in `engine/src/resolve_eoe_d.rs`. Most of the
lane's classes are named after a card and carry no fields (their meaning is the Oracle text and
mtg-bot's docstring; ir_defects 11): each lowers onto ops named after rules actions, its targets
re-derived and, where the IR has a target spec, checked against the class's flags (`optional` against
a minimum of 0, `exclude_self` against `Not(Source)`, `or_spacecraft` against the Spacecraft subtype;
a disagreement blocks the card).

* **Intervening "if"s written as effect wrappers** (`ConditionalOnTappedCreatures`,
  `ConditionalIfYouControlAtLeast`): `hoist_intervening_if` (called from `lower/trigger.rs`) moves
  the condition into the trigger's predicate (`TrigPred::If`, checked as the event happens and again
  on resolution, CR 603.4). Anywhere but a triggered ability they stay blocked.
* **Damage.** `PowerDamageByTarget` (a target creature deals damage equal to its power to another
  target or to itself; it is the source, so its deathtouch and lifelink apply, CR 120.3; twice that
  if it matches a filter: Cut Propulsion's flying), `CountControlled` + `Amount::Remembered` (Focus
  Fire's "2 plus the creatures and/or Spacecraft you control"), `Filter::Blocking`.
* **"Wasn't dealt damage this turn"** (Faller's Faithful): `Mark::DealtDamage(turn)`, kept by
  `deal_damage` only when the card table reads `Filter::DealtDamageThisTurn` (`CardDb::watch_damage`,
  false for the cube: no cube game changes). The draw doesn't need the destruction (an indestructible
  creature's controller draws too).
* **P/T from a number.** `ApplyPtTimes` (+p*n/+t*n, n read once: the source's power, a remembered
  power for "double its power" (CR 701.10b), the artifacts you control).
* **Granted "when this creature dies" until end of turn** (Perigee Beckoner):
  `Mark::DiesTriggerThisTurn`, fired by `move_card` as `Mark::LeaveTrigger` is and removed by
  `end_turn_effects` (CR 514.2); `ReturnEventCardTapped` puts the card back tapped (it enters tapped,
  never "becomes tapped": a Hemosymbic Mite returned this way doesn't trigger).
* **Control until end of turn** (Systems Override, Mutinous Massacre): `GainControlUntilEndOfTurn`
  changes control (`change_control`) and records `Mod::ControlFrom(previous)` on the object until end
  of turn (an effect with no characteristic change); when the "until end of turn" effects end (CR
  514.2), each permanent still controlled by an effect's player returns to the player before it,
  latest effect first (CR 613.1b, 613.7).
* **Life gained this turn** (Haliya, Guided by Light: "draw a card if you've gained 3 or more life
  this turn", checked as the ability resolves; the "if" ends the sentence, so not an intervening
  "if"): `Player.life_gained`, `Cond::GainedLifeAtLeast`. The public-state gate (ENGINE.md 58)
  classifies it Public, with a perturbation made on player 0 without a draw from the gate's random
  stream (a draw shifts every later perturbation's position and turned up two unrelated gaps: kept
  out of this branch) and a Design limit: layout v5 encodes whether a player gained life this turn,
  not how much.
* **Prevention.** `Mod::PreventCombatDamage` (`Flags::prevent_combat_damage`), a rules effect on every
  creature until end of turn (`ApplyRules`, so creatures that come later are covered too): combat
  damage from such a creature is prevented in `deal_damage` (CR 615.1a), unless "can't be prevented"
  (Questing Beast's `combat_unpreventable`).
* **Others.** `DelayedWhen::EndOfCombat` (CR 511.2: Kavaron Harrier's token), the Blocks event's
  attacker slot (CR 509.3b: Skystinger), `DuringYourTurn` -> `Cond::YourTurn`, `each_player` token
  creation (APNAP), "sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped permanent" (`SacrificeSourceUnlessTap`,
  `ChoosePermanent` / `PASS`), "your life total becomes half your starting life total, rounded up"
  (CR 119.5: the difference is gained or lost), "lose half their life, rounded up", "mill half their
  library, rounded down", "destroy all creatures with toughness X or less" remembering the cards put
  into a graveyard for "return one of them if X is 6 or more" (`ChooseGraveyardCard`), "choose odd or
  even" (`ChooseMode`, as Gollum's), `Filter::MvAtMostLandsYouControl`, a delayed trigger about a
  target. Every choice is a decision: the "may"s (`YesNo`), the sacrifices (`Sacrifice`/`PASS`), the
  untap-or-sacrifice, the parity, the returned card, the hand card.

**IR defects (docs/ir_defects.md 80-82, `lower::IR_DEFECTS` under `// Lane D`).** 80 Syr Vondam,
Sunstar Exemplar ("dies or is put into exile" widened to `leaves_battlefield`, and "while its power
is 4 or greater" moved to resolution); 81 Dawnsire, Sunstar Dreadnought ("creature or planeswalker":
the planeswalker dropped); 82 Entropic Battlecruiser ("they lose 3 life", the discarding player,
written as a target).

**Cross-lane features done (tested on custom IR cards; their cards wait for another lane):**
`DestroyTargetCreature` (Embrace Oblivion: A; Vote Out: B), `ConditionalOnTappedCreatures` (Sunstar
Chaplain: A), `DuringYourTurn` (Alpharael, Dreaming Acolyte: C), `DealDamageToTargetCreature.optional`
(Pinnacle Kill-Ship: A), `DealDamageToTargetOpponent` (Biotech Specialist: B),
`DealDamageToTargetTappedCreature` (Reroute Systems: A), `DealDamageEqualToSourcePowerAnyTarget`
(Rust Harvester: A), `TapAnotherTargetCreature` (Starport Security: C),
`ReturnUpToNTargetCreaturesToOwnersHands` (Specimen Freighter: A, C),
`OptionalPutCreatureFromHandOntoBattlefield` (Sledge-Class Seedship: A),
`GainControlOfTargetSliverPermanently` (Sliver Overlord: C), `ConditionalIfYouControlAtLeast`

`DefendingPlayerLosesHalfLifeRoundedUp` (Alpharael, Stonechosen: C).

**Left blocked in the lane, and why.**
* The Dominion Bracelet: controlling another player's turn (CR 722) is a subsystem of its own (who

**Shared files touched (small, additive):** `db.rs` (`DelayedWhen::EndOfCombat`, the Blocks slots, `Cond::GainedLifeAtLeast`,

### 99.7 Merges into `eoe-base` (maintainer)

* **Lane B** (2026-11-08): fast-forward to `eoe-b-lands` 13f2295.
* **Lane C** (2026-11-08): merge of `eoe-c-void` fb3f66c. Ten files conflicted, every conflict
  additive (both lanes appended enum variants, match arms, a `pub mod`, docs). Two catch-alls both
  lanes had taken over were chained: `lower/printing.rs`'s cost-reduction conditions
  (`PerDifferentlyNamedLand` to lane B's `lower_discount_eoe_b`, every other condition to lane C's
  `cost_reduction`, which records the blocker) and `lower/trigger.rs`'s state predicates (lane C's
  `VoidActive` arm, then lane B's catch-all). The combination completes one cross-lane card,
  **Thaumaton Torpedo** (lane B's "destroy target nonland permanent" + lane C's "if you attacked
  with a <subtype>" reduction): `SUPPORTED_EOE_CROSS`, `tests/cards_eoe_cross.rs` (the real card,
  with a custom artifact-creature Spacecraft to attack with; Station is lane A's). EoE support
  **130 / 320** (base 84, B 14, C 31, cross 1).
* **Lane A** (2026-11-08): merge of `eoe-a-station` be7fc39. Seven files conflicted, additive

### 99.8 The cross-lane pass (branch `eoe-cross`, from `eoe-base` 63a3b0b)

**Why.** The lanes' merges completed 13 cross-lane cards (99.7), of which only Thaumaton Torpedo had
card tests, and left the lane features that no lane started (each lane's "not done" list). This
branch writes the owed card tests, then finishes more blocked cards, commons and uncommons first,
skipping every card with an `ir_defect(...)` blocker (99.9's).

**Card tests of the cross-lane cards** (`tests/cards_eoe_cross_cards.rs`, 23 tests; the card table
`tests/eoe_x_kit`: the EoE table plus custom IR test cards, never in the fuzz or digest pools).
Broodguard Elite (X counters as it enters, warp {X}{G}, its counters moved as it leaves, X = 0),
Embrace Oblivion (the sacrifice, "creature or Spacecraft": a noncreature Spacecraft yes, a
noncreature artifact no), Hardlight Containment (enchant artifact you control, the linked exile and
its return under the owner's control, CR 610.3 / 610.3c; gone before its trigger resolves, nothing is
exiled, 610.3b; ward {1} countering an opponent's Mental Modulation), Hylderblade (equip {4}, +3/+1,
the void end-step attach and no trigger without void), Mental Modulation (both costs, its target
types, the draw), Pinnacle Kill-Ship ("up to one", station 7: a 7/7 flyer), Reroute Systems (both
modes), Sledge-Class Seedship (the attack trigger's may: the creature put in isn't attacking, 508.4),
Sliver Overlord (the Sliver search; control that lasts past the turn), Specimen Freighter (up to two
non-Spacecraft creatures, station 9, the defending player's mill), Starport Security (another target;
{2} less with a +1/+1-counter creature of yours only). Every one behaves as its Oracle text says.
Read and kept: Specimen Freighter's "defending player mills four cards" is `EachOpponentMillsCards`,
the same player in a two-player game (CR 506.2); a line after an "N+ |" line (The Seriema's "other
tapped legendary creatures ...", the attack triggers of four Spacecraft, Debris Field Crusher's pump)
is untiered in the IR, as the Oracle text writes it (CR 722.4: an ability not preceded by a station
symbol is treated normally).

**Taken off, IR defects** (docs/ir_defects.md 100-101, `lower::IR_DEFECTS` under "Cross-lane pass"):

* 100 **Fell Gravship** (in `SUPPORTED_EOE_CROSS` since lane A's merge): "mill three cards, then
  return a creature or Spacecraft card from your graveyard to your hand" is a choice made as the
  ability resolves, after the mill; the IR's `ReturnCreatureFromYourGraveyardToHand` is a targeted
  class (the card chosen as the trigger goes on the stack, so a milled card can't be returned, and
  with no target the mill is lost too, CR 603.3d). `SUPPORTED_EOE_CROSS` 13 -> 12.
* 101 **Desculpting Blast**: the Drone token of "if it was attacking, create a 1/1 ... Drone" is a
  flag, its printing looked up by name in Python (as entry 65; a Drone is no predefined token, CR
  111.10).

**Newly supported (12):** Alpharael, Dreaming Acolyte; Atomic Microsizer; Full Bore; Larval
Scoutlander; Roving Actuator; Seedship Impact; Survey Mechan; Tapestry Warden; Terrapact
Intimidator; Vote Out (uncommons); Infinite Guideline Station; The Seriema (rares). Their tests:
`tests/cards_eoe_cross_more.rs` (32).

**How.** New instructions `Ext::EoeX(EoeX)` (`engine/src/eoe_x.rs`), the lowering
`engine/src/lower/eoe_x.rs` (a link in `lower_effect`'s chain); ops named after rules actions:

* `SearchUpToOntoBattlefield` (Larval Scoutlander's "search for up to two basic land cards, put them
  onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle"): one search (CR 701.23a; fewer may be found, 701.23b),
  the decisions of `Ext::SearchAnyNumber` with a cap, the cards put onto the battlefield together.
  "You may sacrifice a land or Lander" is the existing `SacrificeThen` (a land or the Lander
  subtype).
* `DiscardMatchingOrContinue` (Alpharael's "discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card",
  CR 701.9a): a `Discard` decision among the matching hand cards or `PASS`; discarded, the two-card
  discard is skipped; no decision without a matching card.
* `ExileTargetCastCopyFree` (Roving Actuator: "exile up to one target instant or sorcery card with
  mana value 2 or less from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana
  cost"): the card is exiled, a copy of it is made in exile (CR 707.12; a slot made as a copy, as a
  prepare spell's copy, 722.3c), and a `YesNo` (`YES` only if it can be cast now) casts it during the
  resolution (608.2g, `cast_free_now`); declined, it ceases to exist at the next state-based check
  (704.5e); cast, it ceases to exist as it leaves the stack (707.10a).
* On existing ops: Survey Mechan (two targets, "any target" and a player, each checked on its own,
  608.2b; the sacrificed creature deals the damage, 608.2h), Seedship Impact (the target's mana value
  read before it is destroyed, which destroying doesn't change, then the rules' Lander, lane B's
  definition), Terrapact Intimidator (`May` asked of the target opponent, 608.2d), Atomic
  Microsizer (can't be blocked and base 1/1 until end of turn, layer 7b), Infinite Guideline Station
  (`CreateTokensN` with `Amount::MulticoloredPermanents`).
* **Full Bore** ("if that creature was cast for its warp cost, it also gains trample and haste"):
  `Mark::WarpCast` on a permanent that entered as a spell cast for its warp cost (set where warp's
  entering is handled, `put_onto_battlefield_attached`), `Filter::CastForWarp`, and
  `PumpTargetCreatureUntilEOT.granted_keywords_if_warp_cast` (a `JumpUnlessTarget`). A new object
  (the card exiled by warp and cast again from exile for its mana cost) has no mark (CR 400.7). It
  is public state layout v5 can't see (warp's delayed exile is encoded as a count per player only):
  `public_state.rs` perturbs it ("a creature was cast for its warp cost": the first creature in the
  encoded slots, no draw from the gate's random stream) and lists it as the third `NextLayout` gap
  (void is the second); `tests/az.rs::public_state_reaches_the_encoding` expects three.
* **The Seriema**: the static scope `OtherTappedLegendaryCreaturesYouControl`
  (`lower/statics.rs`); `Filter::Tapped` is allowed in static scopes (`layers.rs::scope_matches`,
  `scope_filter_ok`): being tapped is no characteristic, nothing recurses (as `HasCounter`).
* **Convoke** (Vote Out; CR 702.51): `CastingRules::convoke` (the card's own, from `has_convoke`;
  denied on a land or with improvise), `PayMana::convoke`, `Game::convoke_classes` (`pay.rs`): each
  untapped creature its controller controls is a source of one unit of its colours (a pip of one of
  them, or generic; a colourless creature generic only; summoning sickness doesn't matter, 302.6),
  the `IMPROVISE` slot (tapped after the mana abilities, never a mana ability, so "whenever you tap a
  creature for mana" doesn't see it), `RESTRICTED` so Wizard's Rockets never turns it into colours
  (it can't pay the Rockets' {X}). No mana is spent by it (702.51a): converge skips `IMPROVISE`
  sources (improvise's units, of no colour, added none before either). Castability adds the classes
  where improvise does (`hand_castable`, `route_payable`; `pay_classes` takes the flag).
  `tests/support.rs::a_new_ir_field_value_is_a_blocker` used `has_convoke` as its unsupported flag:
  it uses `nonbasic_lands_are_mountains` now (Magus of the Moon's, still unbuilt).
* **Tapestry Warden** ("each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns
  combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power" and "... stations permanents using
  its toughness rather than its power"): `CardDef::{toughness_assigns_damage, toughness_stations}`;
  `Game::combat_damage_amount` replaces the power read in `combat_damage` (attackers and blockers,
  CR 510.1a, 510.1c-d; the damage-assignment decisions get that amount), `station_amount` replaces
  it in `tapped_power` (CR 702.184c), read as the ability resolves; for a tapped creature gone by
  then, its toughness and controller as it last existed (`Game::lki_toughness`, recorded as a
  permanent leaves the battlefield and cleared each turn like the other last-known records; 608.2h).
  All of it only when a card of the table has such a static (`CardDb::watch_toughness`, false for
  the cube: nothing changes there).

**Shared files touched (small, additive):** `lib.rs`, `program.rs` (`Ext::EoeX`, `uses_event`,
`jump_target`), `resolve_ext.rs` (dispatch), `db.rs` (`Filter::CastForWarp`,
`CastingRules::convoke`, the two `CardDef` toughness flags, `CardDb::watch_toughness`), `game.rs`
(`Mark::WarpCast` and where it is set, `lki_toughness` and where it is kept), `cast.rs` (the filter's
arm; convoke beside improvise), `pay.rs` (convoke), `layers.rs` and `lower/statics.rs` (the scope),
`lower/{mod, effect, effect_ext, printing}.rs` (hooks, the convoke and toughness flags,
`IR_DEFECTS`), `combat.rs` and `resolve_eoe_a.rs` (one call each), `flow.rs` (the record's reset),
`public_state.rs`, `tests/az.rs`, `tests/support.rs`.

**Left blocked, and why** (no card with an `ir_defect(...)` blocker attempted: 99.9's):

* Declined, a subsystem each (as the lanes said): Robe of Stars (phasing, CR 702.26), The Dominion
  Bracelet (controlling another player's turn), Blade of the Swarm (an exiled card as a target: no
  action slot, a layout change).
* Gene Pollinator (the set's last blocked common without an IR defect): "{T}, Tap an untapped
  permanent you control: Add one mana of any color". Payment would need a source per other untapped
  permanent with a Pollinator tapped as well, as Orcish Lumberjack's `LJ_FOR` with `Class::share`;
  but the permanent tapped may itself be a Pollinator, which a share count can't see (a Lumberjack is
  never the Forest it sacrifices): new payment work, not started.
* Close Encounter: an additional cost that chooses (pays nothing) "a creature you control or a warped
  creature card you own in exile": one choice across the battlefield and exile, noted on the spell;
  no such cost or decision exists.
* Scout for Survivors: "total mana value 3 or less" constrains the set of targets (`TargetReq` can't
  say it). Steelswarm Operator, Eldrazi Temple, Plaza of Heroes: mana restricted to activated
  abilities or to kinds of spells the payment model's restricted mana doesn't cover (artifact spells
  only). Magus of the Moon (305.7 layer 4 land types), Raging Ravine (latent triggered abilities).
* Rares and mythics with a feature of their own, not attempted: Sunstar Chaplain (cost "remove a
  +1/+1 counter from a creature you control"), Rust Harvester (cost "exile an artifact card from your
  graveyard": a filtered graveyard exile), Astelli Reclaimer and Dyadrine (the mana spent to cast
  it), Mm'menon, the Right Hand, Requiem Monolith, Terminal Velocity, Possibility Technician, Chorale
  of the Void, Pain for All, Frenzied Baloth, Ragost, Secluded Starforge, Sothera, Famished

**Results** (code at 81b150d). EoE support **221 / 320** (base 84, A 32, B 14, C 31, D 36, cross
24); cube 546 / 546. Behaviour digests unchanged (combined `f6543eb2b1b8752f`). The full engine
suite (`cargo test --release -p engine`): 1,791 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored (d476ad1: 1,736; the 55
more are this branch's card tests). The public-state gate: 135 perturbations encoded, 5 deliberate
limits, 3 gaps for the next layout. `FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000`: 20,000 games (wins 9,668 /
9,717, 615 draws, mean 34.4 turns, 420.2 decisions), all four fuzz tests passed (730 s). The default
`FUZZ_GAMES=20000`: 20,000 games (9,967 / 9,994, 39 draws, as before the branch) and 1,000 matches,
passed (397 s). (E: filled to 0 bytes for a while during the runs; the suite was run once it had
room again.)

**Fix after the merge (eoe-base 38d6a3b): the copy decision under `determinize`.** The merged
pool's EoE fuzz, seed 624: "determinize changed the view of P1" at Roving Actuator's "cast the
copy?" question. `determinize` refreshes a pending decision by running its task again; the task of
`EoeX::ExileTargetCastCopyFree` exiled the target card and made the copy before it asked, so the
second run found the card already in exile, asked nothing and let the ability run on past the
question (in that world the copy ceased to exist and priority moved: the views differed). An op
that suspends must be able to run again until it is answered: the copy, kept in the frame's
`picked`, now marks the work as done (a copy slot in exile), and only the question is asked again
(`eoe_x.rs`). No hidden information is involved (the card, its copy and exile are public).
`tests/cards_eoe_cross_more.rs::roving_actuator_pending_copy_decision_survives_determinize_cr707_12`
builds the position and determinizes it for both viewers (the views, the decider's actions, the
copy made once, the world playing on); it fails without the fix. Results on 38d6a3b + the fix: seed 624 passes; `FUZZ_POOL=eoe
FUZZ_GAMES=20000` 20,000 games (wins 9,091 / 9,081, 1,828 draws, mean 38.9 turns, 500.4 decisions),
all four fuzz tests passed (1,215 s); the default `FUZZ_GAMES=20000` 20,000 games (9,967 / 9,994, 39
draws) and 1,000 matches, passed; the full engine suite 1,853 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored;
behaviour digests unchanged (`f6543eb2b1b8752f`).

### 99.9 The IR-fix batch (branch `eoe-irfix`, mtg-bot `feature/eoe-ir-fixes` 5362f5ed)

**Why.** The four lanes found the IR dropping or contradicting the Oracle text of about 45 EoE cards
(docs/ir_defects.md 20-82); the engine blocked them through `lower::IR_DEFECTS`. One batch of
parser fixes in mtg-bot, one re-export, `generated.rs` regenerated once.

**The parser fixes** (mtg-bot `feature/eoe-ir-fixes` 5362f5ed, from main 2cb79f77; each fixed entry's
last bullet in docs/ir_defects.md says what the IR now holds):

* Station (20, 26): the five planets carry `station_threshold: 12` and their "12+ |" activated
  ability (`tier_threshold: 12`), The Eternity Elevator `station_threshold: 20`; none has a power
  or toughness (CR 722.1). The engine's station (99.2) reads them as they are: a planet is a land
  with station that never becomes a creature.
* "{T}: Add {C}." (40): the 19 lands have `produces: ["C"]` and `mana_only_from_produces`.
* The Lander token (42): "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token" (CR 111.10), in every `CreateToken`.
* The white Human Soldier (23 = 51), and the printed colour of every registry token.
* "One or more creatures you control ... deal combat damage to a player" (22, 63):
  `OneOrMoreBatch { per_target_player: true }`, no once-per-turn. The field batches per damaged
  player (mtg-bot's engine plays three players); this engine is two-player, where your creatures
  deal combat damage to your opponent only, so it lowers to the one batch of the combat damage
  step (`TrigPred::Batch`, `lower/trigger.rs`): a first-strike step and the regular step trigger
  twice.
* "Enters with" counters (21): Dockworker Drone and Blast Zone as `enters_with_named_counters`.
* Up to one target (60): `ExileTargetCreatureUntilSourceLeaves.up_to_one` (the target's minimum
  is 0, `lower/eoe_c.rs`).
* Target types (62, 81): Gravkill's "creature or Spacecraft" (`RemoveTargetPermanents`,
  `ObjectOr(IsCreature, HasSubtype(Spacecraft))`), Dawnsire's "creature or planeswalker"
  (`DealDamage`; the lowering's bound for `DealDamage.amount` rises from 99 to 100, its printed
  amount, `lower/effect.rs`).
* The animated Nexus lands (41): `BecomeLandCreatureUEOT.granted_card_types` /
  `granted_subtypes` ("a 1/1 Phyrexian Blinkmoth artifact creature"), lowered into the
  animation's `Mod::Types` (`lower/effect_ext.rs`).
* Starfield Shepherd (48): one search for "a basic Plains card or a creature card with mana value
  1 or less" (`CardFilterAnyOf`, lowered to `Filter::Or` in `lower/filter.rs`), not a mode chosen
  before the search.
* High Market's "sacrifice a creature" (46), Entropic Battlecruiser's event player (82), Nexus of
  Fate's `watched_in_graveyard` (64).

**Not fixed, and why** (still in `lower::IR_DEFECTS`, with their entries): each needs a new IR shape
and its semantics in both engines, and most of the cards have other blockers as well; Archenemy's
Charm and Divert Disaster are pinned to mtg-bot's lossy legacy grammar for mtg-bot's own
cross-engine parity tests (`precise_grammar.RUST_PARITY_PINNED_SPELLS`). Entries 24, 25, 27, 28,
29, 30, 31, 43, 44, 45, 47, 49, 50, 61, 65, 66, 67, 80, and part of 21 (Luxknight Breacher's
per-permanent count), 41 (Mutavault's "all creature types", CR 205.3m: no IR field, no engine
feature) and 62 (Archenemy's Charm). No new IR defect was found (120-139 unused).

**The import** (docs/card_ir.md, "Current numbers"): `cards export-ir --pool cube legacy eoe`,
`filter_eoe_ir.py`, `gen_card_ir.py`; schema `675cfc50fc4e...` (was `70c85fff4b77...`), 707 classes
(5 more) and 4 new fields. `powerlsv.ir.json` and `legacy.ir.json` are the previous files card for
card (`schema_sha256` aside, checked card by card); 53 of `eoe.ir.json`'s 320 cards changed. The
lowering gained the three new shapes above (`granted_card_types` / `granted_subtypes`,
`up_to_one`, `CardFilterAnyOf`; `per_target_player` as noted); `lower::IR_DEFECTS` lost the fixed
cards' 57 lines (it keeps 21 cards). `tests/cards_eoe_b_base.rs` no longer asserts that Knight
Luminary and Cosmogrand Zenith are blocked.

**Cards.** EoE support 210 -> 247 of 320: 37 cards in `SUPPORTED_EOE_IRFIX`, each checked against
its Oracle text. The 12 Lander makers (Beamsaw Prospector, Biomechan Engineer, Biotech Specialist,
Dauntless Scrapbot, Edge Rover, Galactic Wayfarer, Glacier Godmaw, Lithobraking, Sami's Curiosity,
Scrounge for Eternity, Seedship Agrarian, Sunstar Expansionist); the Human Soldier makers
(Cosmogrand Zenith, Honored Knight-Captain, Knight Luminary, Rayblade Trooper); the lands (Bonders'
Enclave, Cathedral of War, Deserted Temple, Inventors' Fair, Mystifying Maze, Terrain Generator,
High Market, Blinkmoth Nexus, Inkmoth Nexus) and planets (Evendo, Waking Haven; Kavaron, Memorial
World; Uthros, Titanic Godcore); All-Fates Stalker, Dawnsire, Sunstar Dreadnought, Dockworker
Drone, Elegy Acolyte, Entropic Battlecruiser, Gravkill, Haliya, Ascendant Cadet, Nexus of Fate,
Starfield Shepherd. Of the cards whose IR is fixed, still blocked by engine features: Adagia
(`CreateTokenCopyOfTargetWithExceptions`: the copy exceptions have no supertype), Susur Secundi
(`DrawCardsEqualTo`: no amount for the sacrificed creature's power), The Eternity Elevator
(`AddChargeCounterManaOfChosenColor`), Bioengineered Future, Blast Zone, Cascading Cataracts,
Crystal Quarry, Contested War Zone, Echoing Deeps, Swarmyard, Thespian's Stage (each blocker in the
support report).

**Tests.** `tests/cards_eoe_irfix.rs` (43 tests: the Lander makers, the Human Soldier makers, the creatures
and spells) and `tests/cards_eoe_irfix_lands.rs` (18: the lands, the Nexus lands, the planets'
station and "12+ |" abilities): every ability of each card's Oracle text, and the edge cases of the
fixes (a tapped Lander can't be activated, CR 602.5a; Haliya and Elegy Acolyte trigger in a
first-strike and a regular combat damage step, 510.4; All-Fates Stalker with no target, 115.1d;
Gravkill on a Spacecraft below its threshold; Dawnsire's 100 damage to a planeswalker; Nexus of Fate
discarded, surveilled or countered goes to the library, 614.1a; Starfield Shepherd finding either
kind; High Market can't sacrifice a noncreature artifact; Dockworker Drone is never on the
battlefield without its counter, 614.1c; the planets' mana abilities only at 12 counters). No card
disagreed with its Oracle text. Nexus of Fate's countered case uses a local table with a custom
counterspell (the set has none for an instant); the engine can't give a player hexproof, so
Entropic Battlecruiser's test checks that no target is chosen.

Full engine suite: 1,797 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored (1,736 before, plus the 61). `support` 8
passed (cube 546 / 546, EoE 247 / 320); behaviour digests unchanged (combined `f6543eb2b1b8752f`);
`FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000`: 20,000 games (wins 9,159 / 9,105, 1,736 draws, mean 38.7 turns,
497.2 decisions), the default `FUZZ_GAMES=20000`: 20,000 games (9,967 / 9,994, 39 draws, as before)
and 1,000 matches, all four fuzz tests passed; `cargo test -p card_ir` and `python -m pytest
tools/codegen` pass. (The E: drive filled up during the work: the full suite and the card tests ran
in a target dir of this worktree's own on C:.)

mtg-bot (`feature/eoe-ir-fixes` 5362f5ed; 7af12b20 adds a test module): `cards roundtrip --pool
cube legacy eoe` passes; its full suite (`pytest -n 8 --no-cov`) has the 51 failures of untouched
main 2cb79f77 and no other; the cross-engine parity probes of the changed EoE printings are strict
xfails (mtg-bot's compiled Rust engine models the old printings; an entry in its
docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md).

**Unchanged:** the cube's IR (card for card), support (546 / 546) and behaviour digests (combined
`f6543eb2b1b8752f`); no layout, encoding, zero-core or Python change.

No branch changes the action layout or the encoding: a card that can only be done with a layout
change is left blocked and reported (the maintainer decides). New public state goes in the
public-state gate's limits as before (a perturbation draws nothing from the shared stream).
Builds use the normal release profile (debug info on): the agents started without debug info to
save space on E:, and the user preferred freeing space to any shortcut, so 39 stale cargo target
dirs of merged or deleted branches (47 GB) were removed instead and the agents switched back.

#### 99.13 W3: combat and abilities (branch `eoe-w3-combat`, from `eoe-base` 3a8dfb6)

**Result.** All 14 of the workstream's cards supported (`SUPPORTED_EOE_COMBAT`): Astelli
Reclaimer, Dyadrine, Synthesis Amalgam, Frenzied Baloth, Pain for All, Possibility Technician,
Raging Ravine, Ragost, Deft Gastronaut, Requiem Monolith, Robe of Stars, Rust Harvester, Secluded
Starforge, Sunstar Chaplain, Swarmyard, Terminal Velocity. EoE support on this branch alone 258 ->
272 / 320. No IR defect found (docs/ir_defects.md 170-179 stay free): each card's IR read against
its Oracle text. No layout or encoding change; cube support 546 / 546 and the behaviour digests
unchanged (`f6543eb2b1b8752f`). Tests: `engine/tests/cards_eoe_w3.rs` (50), card table
`tests/eoe_w3_kit` (the EoE table plus custom IR cards named "W3 ...", never in the fuzz or
digest pools).

**How.** New instructions `Ext::EoeW3(W3)` (`engine/src/eoe_w3.rs`, with the workstream's game
state `Game::w3: W3State` and printing facts `CardDef::w3: W3Def`, one field each in the shared
structs), the lowering `engine/src/lower/eoe_w3.rs` (a link in `lower_effect`'s chain; the cost
atoms; the printing flags; an intervening-if hoist). Ops are named after rules actions:

* **Granted triggered abilities, generalised** (CR 613.1f). Lane D's `Mark::DiesTriggerThisTurn`
  (99.5) becomes `Mark::Granted { def, slot, this_turn, ts }`: any triggered ability an effect
  gives a permanent, until end of turn (the cleanup step ends it, 514.2) or for as long as it is
  that object (400.7). It is the permanent's own ability (its source and controller,
  113.7-113.8), seen by `Game::event` like a printed one (`Game::granted_observers`: a permanent
  on the battlefield, or, for a leave-the-battlefield event, one that left earlier in the same
  move, 603.10a). The grant is a layer-6 effect with its own timestamp (613.1f, 613.7a): a "loses
  all abilities" effect with a later timestamp removes it, one with an earlier timestamp doesn't
  (613.7; the look-back of a leave trigger reads the loss as the permanent left,
  `W3State::lki_loss`). `lower::eoe_w3::grant_triggered_ability` lowers the
  ability as a printed one into the card's delayed triggers (`W3::GrantTrigger`); Perigee
  Beckoner's grant goes through it (its "dies" event's object is the creature as it last
  existed, so `EoeD::ReturnEventCardTapped` now also finds the card it became one move later, as
  `Ext::ReturnEventCardAs` does). Requiem Monolith (`GrantTriggeredAbilityUEOT`; "you draw that
  many cards and lose that much life", the event's amount; "that creature's controller may have
  this artifact deal 1 damage to it": `Op::May` asked of the target's controller, 608.2d),
  Raging Ravine (`BecomeLandCreatureUEOT.granted_triggered_abilities`), Terminal Velocity (two
  abilities for good on the permanent put from the hand, plus haste; "it deals damage equal to
  its mana value to each creature" as it leaves: `W3::DamageEachSourceMv`, the permanent as it
  last existed, its last-known damage source kept via `SEEN_LKI_DAMAGE`).
* **Regeneration** (CR 701.19; Swarmyard). `W3::Regenerate` puts a shield on the object
  (`Mark::RegenShield`, one per shield, ended by the cleanup step); `Game::destroy` (destroy
  effects and the 704.5g/h state-based destruction alike) uses one up instead: damage removed,
  tapped by its controller, removed from combat (701.19a, 506.4). "It can't be regenerated"
  (701.19c; the cube's Damn, Snuff Out and Wrath of God, where nothing regenerates: no change
  there) sets `W3State::no_regen` around the destruction (`W3::CantBeRegenerated`).
* **Phasing** (CR 702.26; Robe of Stars). `Zone::PhasedOut`: a phased-out permanent leaves the
  battlefield list without changing zones (702.26d: the same object, inc unchanged, its counters
  and effects kept, no enter or leave triggers), so every "each permanent" loop and every
  battlefield check treats it as though it doesn't exist (702.26b) with nothing to gate: no cube
  card phases and no loop changed. What is attached to it phases out with it (indirectly,
  702.26e; `W3State::indirect`); a creature leaves combat (506.4); damage on it is removed in the
  cleanup step (514.2); the static fast paths' counts follow it. In its controller's untap step,
  before untapping (502.1), it phases in with what phased out with it, attached again (702.26h),
  in timestamp order. `W3::PhaseOut` ("equipped creature phases out": `On::Each(Filter::
  HostOfSource)`).
* **The mana spent to cast a spell** (CR 601.2h; Astelli Reclaimer, Dyadrine). The payment of a
  spell whose card reads it records it (`Mark::ManaSpent`: the payment's units, none for a
  creature tapped for convoke or an artifact for improvise), and the permanent the spell becomes
  keeps it. `Filter::MvAtMostManaSpent` (Astelli's target: X = 5 cast normally, 3 warped, 0 put
  onto the battlefield by Terminal Velocity); `W3Def::counters_mana_spent` (Dyadrine enters with
  that many +1/+1 counters, 122.6, 614.1c); `W3::RemoveCounterFromEachMay` (Dyadrine's attack
  trigger: two different creatures as a set, `PASS` first; no question when impossible; the
  removal only after both are chosen, so a determinize refresh re-asks, 99.8).
* **Costs.** "Exile an artifact card from your graveyard" (`Cost::exile_graveyard_types`, the
  printed types, 400.7; Rust Harvester), "remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control"
  (`Cost::remove_counter_from`, a `ChoosePermanent`; the mana payment reserves one such creature
  as it does a sacrifice's, `Keep::sac`, since a mana ability that sacrifices it comes first,
  601.2g-h: fuzz seed 2219, an Eldrazi Scion with the only counter sacrificed for the {2};
  Sunstar Chaplain), "tap X untapped artifacts you control" (`Cost::tap_x`; Secluded Starforge:
  X announced, 107.3a / 601.2b; paid as the rules order it, the mana abilities first, 601.2g,
  then the taps, 601.2h, chosen among the untapped artifacts left; the order of 601.2h's parts
  among themselves changes nothing, nothing happening between them, and the player makes every
  choice the rules give, which sources make the mana and which artifacts are tapped: the mana payment reserves X
  of them, `Game::tap_x_reserve`, `Keep::sac` with `Keep::sac_taps`, so a source whose
  activation taps or sacrifices one, its own {T} or sacrifice, another's "tap an untapped
  artifact" or "sacrifice an artifact", uses it up while one that doesn't, Pentad Prism's
  counters, stays free; X at most what the payment can leave, `Game::tap_x_most`), "sacrifice
  a Food".
  `PumpTargetCreatureUntilEOT.power_bonus_from_x` (+X/+0, `Ext::ApplyPtX`).
* **"Combat damage can't be prevented"** (CR 615.12, `W3Def::combat_unpreventable_all`, read
  where combat damage would be prevented) and **"creature spells you control can't be
  countered"** (CR 101.2, `W3Def::creature_spells_uncounterable`): Frenzied Baloth.
* **Pain for All.** "Enchanted creature deals damage equal to its power to any other target"
  (`W3::HostDamagesPower`: the creature the Aura is attached to, or was as it last existed,
  `W3State::lki_host` kept with `SEEN_W3_HOST`, 608.2h; `Filter::HostOfSource` for "other") and
  "whenever enchanted creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to each opponent"
  (`W3::EventObjDamagesEachOpponent`, the creature as it last existed if it died).
* **Possibility Technician.** `PermKind::Play`'s condition generalised: `only_if: PlayIf {
  Always, AttackedWith(subtype) (lane C's attacked_subtype), ControlSubtype(subtype) }`, read in
  `Game::permission_ok` as the card would be played (601.2a, 305.1); the 19 construction sites
  take `PlayIf::Always`.
* **Ragost.** "Artifacts you control are Foods in addition to their other types"
  (`W3Def::grants_subtype`, read by `Game::has_subtype`): a layer-4 effect with Ragost's
  timestamp (613.7a), applied among the permanent's other type-changing effects in timestamp
  order (613.7, `Game::subtype_with_grants`: an effect that sets its subtypes later removes Food,
  an earlier one doesn't); whether it applies reads the permanent's card types after layer 4,
  since it depends on any effect that makes the permanent stop or start being an artifact
  (613.8a), which then applies first. "... and have '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You
  gain 3 life'" (the Food ability, 111.10b): a latent ability of the card
  (`W3Def::grants_activated`) that each matching permanent has (`Game::granted_activated`,
  613.1f) unless a "loses all abilities" effect on it is later than Ragost's timestamp (613.7),
  in the places after its card's own abilities and activated as the granting definition's
  (`Game::activated_home`). Every activated ability stays reachable (602.2, 117.1b): a permanent
  has four `ACTIVATE` slots, and one with more abilities (its own and granted) keeps the first
  three in theirs while the fourth slot opens a choice among the fourth and later ones
  (`Task::ChooseAbility`, a `ChooseMode` decision: `NUMBER` + place - 3, `NUMBER` + 31 for a
  further page), inside the existing action ranges (`Game::permanent_activations` lists what
  may be activated, `Game::paged_slot` tells the page). Both parts are one ability:
  having applied in layer 4, it goes on applying in layer 6 even if Ragost loses its abilities
  (613.6), so both read Ragost's definition. "At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life
  this turn, untap Ragost": an intervening if (603.4,
  `lower::eoe_w3::hoist_intervening_if_w3`, around `UntapSelf`).

**For the next layout** (the coordinator's additive version after the merges), besides the four

**The public-state gate** (ENGINE.md 58). `W3State.phased` and `.indirect` are Public (in

`tests/az.rs::public_state_reaches_the_encoding` lists them). Granted triggered abilities have no

#### 99.14 W4: exile, graveyard, copies and control (branch `eoe-w4-exile`)

**Cards.** EoE support 258 -> 265 with W4's seven (`SUPPORTED_EOE_EXILE`): Adagia, Windswept
Bastion; Alpharael, Stonechosen; Blade of the Swarm; Chorale of the Void; Close Encounter; Scout for
Survivors; Susur Secundi, Void Altar. Left: The Dominion Bracelet (its rules are built; blocked on
the encoding, below), Sothera, the Supervoid (IR defect 180) and Tannuk, Steadfast Second (an
alternative cost granted by another permanent: not built). Tests: `tests/cards_eoe_w4.rs` (19, and
the Bracelet's 4, ignored while it is blocked; they passed at 84932a5 with the card supported; the
card table `tests/eoe_w4_kit`, the EoE table plus `W4 ...` IR test cards, never in the fuzz or
digest pools). New Rust in `eoe_w4.rs` (`Ext::EoeW4`)
and `lower/eoe_w4.rs` (a link in `lower_effect`'s chain); shared files small and additive.

**Controlling another player (CR 722; The Dominion Bracelet).** "You control target opponent during
their next turn" (`EoeW4::ControlNextTurn`) sets `Game::next_turn_controller[q]` (the last effect
wins, 722.1a); as q's next turn starts (a skipped turn isn't taken, 722.1b) it becomes
`Game::turn_controller`, for the whole turn (722.1). Then:

* *Who decides.* A decision keeps its player (the controlled player: its action ids are that
  player's, their hand, their permanents, their mana, 722.4a); `Game::decider_of` names who makes it
  (722.4: the controller for the active player during the controlled turn; their own decisions stay
  theirs, 722.7), and `Game::to_move` (zero-core's) is the decider. `determinize`'s "the viewer's
  own decision" is the decider's.
* *What the controller sees* (722.3). At the end of every transition of the controlled turn
  (`advance`, before the next decision is shown) `sync_controller_view` lets the controller learn,
  keyed (`KEY_LOOK`, private to it, in definition order), every hidden card the controlled player
  can see: their hand (so the cards they draw), the face-down permanents they control (708.5), the
  face-down exiled cards they know, and the hidden cards their pending decision names (a looked-at
  pile). What they only remember (a library card scried on an earlier turn) is not visible and not
  shared. So the decider knows everything the controlled player's options depend on: its worlds
  never resample them (the decider's actions and view are unchanged by `determinize`, which the
  fuzz checks), and no card the controller can't see is shared. Afterwards the controller still
  knows the cards it saw, until they are rearranged privately (as after a hand reveal). Limits:
  docs/shortcuts.md 99.14.2.
* *The encoding: why the card stays blocked.* The decider's encoding is its own seat's (its hand,
  its permanents as `MY_PERM`, the controlled player's hand only as the known cards it is), but a
  controlled decision's action ids are the controlled player's: `HAND` + k is a slot of *their*
  hand, `MY_PERM` their permanents, `LIBRARY` + k a slot of *their* list (a searched library, a
  pile). Layout v5's input gives those ids no tokens for the decider: `encode` builds the list block
  and the legal-action flags only for the viewer's own decision (`d.player == me`), and has no hand
  slots for the other player's hand. The EoE fuzz found it at 20,000 games (seed 12441, step 164:
  "PutInHand option 340 points at list slot 0 ... not its card's token", `check_list_options`, in a
  controlled turn). Making it work is an encoding change (the brief forbids one; the maintainer's
  decision). What it needs: (1) a controlled decision encoded in the controlled player's frame (the
  seat its ids are relative to: its hand slots with the legal flags, its permanents as `MY_PERM`,
  its list block, its triggers) with the decider's knowledge (the decider's own hand then appears as
  the other player's hand known exactly); (2) a global "this decision is made for the other seat"
  (the value is the decider's, `to_move`'s, while the frame is the controlled player's); (3) the two
  facts below. No action id changes. The card is blocked in the lowering
  (`grants_control_opponent_ability_when_equipped(...encoding...)`); removing that line and adding
  it to `SUPPORTED_EOE_EXILE` restores it once the encoding presents its decisions. Layout v5 also
  has no float for a controlled turn or a pending one: two next-layout gaps in the public-state gate
  ("a player will control the other's next turn", "the active player is controlled this turn";
  perturbations draw nothing from the shared stream; they apply in any position, as the fields
  exist without the card).

**Activated abilities an Equipment grants** (CR 301.5, 613.1f). `CardDef::grants_equipped`: a face
of the Equipment holding the granted abilities (the IR's
`grants_control_opponent_ability_when_equipped`, the Bracelet's whole Oracle text, lowered by
`lower/eoe_w4.rs::grant_control_ability`). The equipped permanent has them while the Equipment is
attached and keeps its abilities (`Game::granted_activated`): offered at priority after its own
(`ACTIVATE` ids past its own; past the fourth slot, the page of ENGINE.md 99.13 since the merge
of W3: docs/shortcuts.md 99.14.3 fixed), activated from the face with
the creature as the source (`Game::activated_home`; its stack item names the face, so the cost,
targets and program are the face's; `Game::activated_of` for the bots). "Exile The Dominion
Bracelet" (`CardDef::exiles_granter`): the Equipment, noted as the ability is activated, is exiled
after the mana (CR 601.2h), so "{X} less, where X is this creature's power" (`Discount::SourcePower`)
reads the power with the Bracelet's +1/+1 as the cost is determined (601.2f).

**Targets in exile** (Blade of the Swarm: "put target exiled card with warp on the bottom of its
owner's library"). 99.4 and 99.8 left it for a layout change; none is needed. `Filter::InExile`,
`Filter::HasWarp` (a card with warp, CR 702.185a, whoever owns it and however it was exiled; face-up
exile only, no copies of cards); exiled cards are target candidates when a filter names exile
(`target_candidates`, `has_candidates`, `filter_ok`'s `exile_ok`); a target's option is `EXILE` +
its place among the decision's offered exiled cards in exile order (`Game::name_exile_targets`, run
by `ask` beside 65.10's graveyard renaming). That is the existing meaning of the `EXILE` range for
a choice of exiled cards (`ChooseExiled`: "the k-th offered card"): the ids, their count and every
existing decision's ids are unchanged, so it is no layout change. Naming by definition (the brief's
suggestion) is not rules-equivalent here: two exiled cards of one definition and owner differ (one
warped, castable from exile later; another with counters or linked to a permanent), and exile is
public, so the card itself is named, as a graveyard target is (65.10). The encoding has no field for
a target in exile (a stack item's target block names players, permanents and stack items): a rare
next-layout gap, "a stack item targets another exiled card".

**Total mana value of targets** (Scout for Survivors: "up to three target creature cards with total
mana value 3 or less"). `TargetReq::total_mv`; the targets are chosen one at a time and only a
candidate keeping the chosen total within the limit is offered (`Game::retain_within_total_mv`; a
copy's new targets too). This equals CR 601.2c's check of the announced set: every set so built is
within the total, and every set within it is built by some order (mana values are never negative,
so each prefix of a legal set is within the total). The targets are graveyard cards, whose mana
values nothing changes there, so the total still holds as the spell resolves (608.2b checks each
target alone). `EoeW4::GraveyardTargetsOntoBattlefield` puts them onto the battlefield together,
then a +1/+1 counter on each (CR 122.1: after they enter, not "enters with").

**Close Encounter** ("As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a creature you control or a
warped creature card you own in exile"). `CastingRules::choose_creature_or_warped`: castable only
with something to choose (`cast_timing_ok`, which every castability check passes through: a cost
that can't be paid, 601.2h); `Task::ChooseForCost`, before the mana: one choice in two decisions, an
exiled card first (`ChooseExiled`, `EXILE` + k; `PASS` = a creature instead, offered when there is
one), then a creature (`ChoosePermanent`); each candidate is reached by exactly one sequence. The
choice is noted on the spell (not a target: no ward, 702.21a). `Game::is_warped`: in exile by warp's
delayed ability (its permission from a later turn, for the mana cost). `Amount::ChosenPower`: the
creature's power now, or as it last existed if it left (608.2h); an exiled card's own power. Which
object a stack item noted is encoded as a count only: a rare next-layout gap, "a stack item noted
another object".

**The other cards.** Adagia: copy exceptions gain supertypes (`Except::supers`, CR 707.9b: "except
it's legendary"); `Game::supertypes_of` reads them for the legend rule (704.5j), static scopes,
filters and spending restrictions; the descriptor's legendary float is the copiable definition's (a
next-layout gap, "a copy is legendary by its exception"). Susur Secundi: `Amount::CostPower`, the
sacrificed creature's power as it last existed (608.2h; the activated item's event object, recorded
as the cost is paid). Alpharael, Stonechosen: `WardCost::DiscardRandom`,
`EoeW4::OfferDiscardRandom` (702.21a, 701.9b; a yes/no, asked with an empty hand too, as ward's life
payment is; the encoding's ward-discard float). Chorale of the Void: the defending player's
graveyard (the trigger controller's opponent: the Aura enchants a creature its controller
controls), onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking (508.4: during combat,
never declared as an attacker; `Task::AttackTarget` if there is a planeswalker to attack).

**IR defect** (docs/ir_defects.md 180, `lower::IR_DEFECTS` under W4): Sothera's end-step ability
returns the creature card before Sothera is sacrificed (the Oracle text sacrifices first); the
order is observable (the returned creature's enters "if"s and leave triggers). Its classes are not
lowered yet either (`EachOpponentExilesOwnCreature`, `ReanimateOneExiledWithSourceWithCounters`,
`SacrificeSelfPreservingExileLink`, `AnyPlayerControlsNoCreatures`).

**Not done: Tannuk, Steadfast Second** ("Artifact cards and red creature cards in your hand have
warp {2}{R}"). No layout change is needed, but an engine subsystem is: an alternative cost a card
has from another permanent. `StackItem::alt` indexes the card's own `alt_costs`, and warp's
consequences read the card's own alternative cost: castability and the `ChooseAltCost` options
(`alt_payable`, `alt_allowed`), the total cost, void and `Mark::WarpCast` (`cast_done`,
`put_onto_battlefield_attached`), and the end-step exile, which is the card's own delayed ability
(`AltCost::dash`). It needs granted alternative costs (an index past the card's own, resolved to
the granting permanent's face, as 99.14's granted activated abilities are) and a warp delayed
ability held by that face.

**Public-state gate.** Five new next-layout gaps (eight in all; `tests/az.rs` expects them): a copy
legendary by its exception, a target in exile, which object a stack item noted, a pending
player-controlling effect, a controlled turn. Two new public fields (`Game::next_turn_controller`,
`Game::turn_controller`), in `Game::view_of`.

engine suite 1,876 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored; behaviour digests unchanged (combined
`f6543eb2b1b8752f`); the default `FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed (20,000 games, wins 9,967 / 9,994, 39
draws, as before the branch; 1,000 matches); `FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000` failed at seed 12441
(the encoding, above). At 2ac16df (the Bracelet blocked, EoE support 265; cube 546 / 546):
`support`, `cards_eoe_w4` (19 passed, 4 ignored), `--test az` (41) pass, digests unchanged
(`f6543eb2b1b8752f`), and `FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed (20,000 games, wins 9,100 /
9,009, 1,891 draws, mean 39.6 turns, 515.6 decisions; all four fuzz tests, 1,022 s). The
public-state gate: 135 perturbations encoded, 5 deliberate limits, 8 next-layout gaps.

#### 99.15 W5: Tannuk (branch `eoe-w5-tannuk`)

**The card.** Tannuk, Steadfast Second: "Other creatures you control have haste. / Artifact cards and
red creature cards in your hand have warp {2}{R}." Its haste was supported; its blocker was
`CardPrinting.hand_ability_grants`: an alternative cost another permanent's static ability gives
cards in hand (CR 118.9, 604.1, 611.3a, 702.185a). EoE support 265 -> 266 (`SUPPORTED_EOE_W5`).
New Rust in `eoe_w5.rs` and `lower/eoe_w5.rs`; shared files small and additive.

**The rules, as built.**

* *Which cards* (CR 611.3a, 109.5). A grant (`CastingRules::hand_alt_grants`: a filter and an
  `AltCost`) applies to each card in the hand of its permanent's controller that matches the filter
  now (`Game::granted_alts`: the owner's permanents in battlefield order, their grants in order;
  `abilities()`, so a permanent that lost its abilities grants nothing). The IR's
  `HandCardFilter` is a disjunction of (card type, optional colour): `Or(Type(artifact),
  And(Type(creature), Color(R)))`; a multicoloured red card is red (CR 105.2).
* *Faces* (CR 601.3e). Whether a face can be cast with it is decided by the face's
  characteristics: the hand's offer copies the game with the face up (`face_castable`), and the
  cast asks with the face on the stack. A modal double-faced card whose back face is a red
  creature can be cast as that face for {2}{R}; an adventurer red creature card's Adventure (a
  sorcery) has no warp (the creature does). This is Henzie "Toolbox" Torre's ruling for granted
  blitz (a modal back face) and Lier's ruling of 2025-10-02 (alternative characteristics are what
  is legal to cast).
* *From hand only* (CR 702.185a: "cast this card from your hand"). `alt_payable` refuses a granted
  index for any other route (exile, graveyard, miracle: `CastFrom::Hand` only).
* *One alternative cost* (CR 118.9a, 601.2b). Granted costs join `ChooseAltCost` beside the mana
  cost (`NUMBER` 0), the card's own (`NUMBER` 1 + k) and Weftwalking's free cast (`NUMBER` 31); the
  card's own warp and Tannuk's are two choices (Memorial Team Leader: four options). A spell cast
  for a granted cost isn't overloaded (CR 702.96a: overload is an alternative cost of its own), so
  the option needs the spell's own targets, as its mana cost does.
* *Naming a granted cost.* `ChooseAltCost` names a granted cost by its permanent: `Choice::Card(g)`
  with the permanent's `MY_PERM` id (`perm_action`), so any number of granters stays reachable
  within the existing ranges (the legend rule keeps one Tannuk a player in this table, but that is
  a property of the pool, not a rule this code relies on). A printing has at most one grant (the
  lowering denies more, `hand_ability_grants(more than one ...)`), so the permanent names it. The
  encoder needs nothing new: a legal `MY_PERM` id sets that permanent token's `OPTION` float, as
  for any choice of a permanent. Chosen, `StackItem::alt` is one past the card's own alternative
  costs (encoded as `stack::ALT` / `ALT_INDEX`, public) and the spell carries
  `Mark::AltGranted { granter, def, grant }`.
* *The cost* (CR 118.9d, 601.2f). The granted mana with the spell's increases and reductions
  (`alt_mana_of`, shared with the card's own alternative costs): "noncreature spells cost {1}
  more" makes an artifact's warp {3}{R}; Uthros Psionicist's "the second spell ... costs {2} less"
  makes it {R}. Once chosen, everything reads the noted cost (`Game::item_alt`): the total cost is
  locked in (601.2f) even if the granter is sacrificed for mana while it is paid.
* *X* (CR 107.3b). A granted cost has no {X} (the lowering denies one), so a spell with {X} in its
  mana cost cast with it has X = 0: `choose_x` offers 0 only (`cast_for_granted_alt`).
* *Keeping the ability* (CR 400.7g, 611.3a-b). The spell keeps the granted warp while the granting
  effect would still apply to it: the same object (`ObjRef`) on the battlefield, controlled by the
  card's owner ("your hand"), not having lost its abilities, the same definition, the spell
  matching the filter (`Game::alt_grant_applies`). Only the grant it was cast with continues
  (400.7g speaks of the ability used; blitz's 702.152b links each instance to its own payment).
  400.7g carries the effect across the move from the hand, nothing else: the effect applies at
  each moment to what its text says (611.3a), and "your hand" is its permanent's controller's
  (109.5), so a granter that changed controllers no longer gives the spell (cast from its owner's
  hand) the ability, and one that left or lost the ability gives nothing (611.3b).
* *Warp's exile* (CR 608.3g, 702.185a). The delayed "exile the permanent ... at the beginning of
  the next end step" is created as the permanent enters, by the spell's warp ability: only if the
  spell still has it then. `finish_resolve` passes the delayed ability with its home
  (`Game::entering_dash: Option<(u8, Option<DefId>)>`: the card's own definition, or the granting
  definition, whose delayed ability `lower/eoe_w5.rs` builds as a card's own warp's,
  `Ext::WarpExile`). Its source is still the permanent (603.7d); the log and the stack item name
  the definition holding the program ("trigger of Tannuk"). Tannuk dying in response: the permanent
  stays. Then "its owner may cast this card after the current turn has ended" (the permission
  `Ext::WarpExile` gives), for its mana cost: in exile it has no warp.
* *Cast for its warp cost* (CR 702.185c, 400.7d). Void and `Mark::WarpCast` (Full Bore's "if that
  creature was cast for its warp cost") hold whenever it was cast for a warp cost, own or granted,
  whether or not the spell still had the ability as it resolved.
* *Warped / with warp* (CR 702.185b). A card exiled by a granted warp's delayed ability is a warped
  card (`is_warped` reads the permission: Close Encounter may choose it); it has no warp in exile
  (`Filter::HasWarp` adds a granted warp only in hand, or on a spell still having it: Blade of the
  Swarm can't target it).
* *Copies* (CR 707.10, 707.2). A copy of a spell cast for a granted cost copies the choice
  (`alt`) but not the ability (not a copiable value, not a card cast from a hand): `item_alt` finds
  no `Mark::AltGranted` on the copy, so no exile and no "cast for its warp cost". No IR class
  copies a creature or artifact spell today, so no test drives it. For the same reason (a copy of
  a spell isn't cast) `put_onto_battlefield` now sets `Mark::WarpCast` only when the permanent's
  spell was cast and not a copy (the `Enters` note's "cast" bit's condition); before, a copy of a
  spell cast for its own warp cost was marked.

**Hidden information.** The granted offer is part of its controller's own options (the encoding's
legal flags are the decider's only); `tests/cards_eoe_w5.rs` checks that P1's encoding is the same
whether P0's hand card has Tannuk's warp or not. A spell being cast is public; `ChooseAltCost` is
asked with the cast in progress (the caster's hand pinned as for any payment).

**Encoding.** No layout or action-id change. `az/encode.rs`'s `Task::Delve` context computed the
cost floats only for an alternative cost index within the card's own; it now asks `item_alt`, the
same value for every state reachable before, and the noted granted cost for a delve spell cast for
one. The public-state gate gains one rare next-layout gap (nine in all; `tests/az.rs`): "a spell's
granted alternative cost came from another permanent" (which permanent is not encoded; the next
layout encodes it as a noted object's). `az/view.rs` words the option ("The alternative cost
Tannuk, Steadfast Second gives").

**Tests.** `tests/cards_eoe_w5.rs` (11; the card table `tests/eoe_w5_kit`, the EoE table plus
`W5 ...` IR test cards, never in the fuzz or digest pools): which cards have it (611.3a), the
controller's hand only (109.5), the cast, void, haste, the exile and the later cast (702.185a),
Tannuk dying in response (608.3g, 400.7g; Full Bore after), the grant ending (611.3b), one
alternative cost (118.9a), increases and reductions (118.9d), X = 0 (107.3b), faces (601.3e),
warped without warp (702.185b), and the hidden hand.

**Limits.** None added (no docs/shortcuts.md entry). A printing with more than one hand grant is
not supported (the lowering says so); no card has one.

**Results** (normal release profile, at 18e9da9; EoE support 266, cube 546 / 546). The full engine
suite 1,883 passed, 0 failed, 19 ignored; behaviour digests unchanged (combined
`f6543eb2b1b8752f`); `FUZZ_POOL=eoe FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed (20,000 games, wins 9,037 / 9,041,
1,922 draws, mean 39.6 turns, 515.0 decisions; 1,483 s); the default `FUZZ_GAMES=20000` passed
(20,000 games, wins 9,967 / 9,994, 39 draws, as before the branch; 1,000 matches; 455 s). Random
play reaches the mechanism: 300 random-action games of a Tannuk deck (four Tannuks, red creatures,
Mountains) cast 301 spells for Tannuk's warp and exiled 273 permanents with it. The public-state
gate: 135 perturbations encoded, 5 deliberate limits, 9 next-layout gaps.

#### 99.12 W2: mana and lands (branch `eoe-w2-mana`, from `eoe-base` 3a8dfb6)

**Why.** The W2 share of the set's last 62 cards (99.11-99.14): Blast Zone, Bioengineered Future,
Cascading Cataracts, Contested War Zone, Crystal Quarry, Echoing Deeps, Eldrazi Temple, Famished
Worldsire, Gene Pollinator, Magus of the Moon, Mm'menon, the Right Hand, Plaza of Heroes, Steelswarm
Operator, The Eternity Elevator, Thespian's Stage; and every mana spending restriction (Sunken
Citadel's and Power Depot's too, whose IR W1 fixes).

**Spending restrictions (CR 106.6; `eoe_w2.rs`).** `ManaAbility::only` is now the set of purposes
the mana may be spent on, any one of them (`eoe_w2::spendable`: no restriction, or a purpose in
common with the payment's `Keep::allow`); for the cube's two one-purpose kinds this is the old rule.
New purposes (`db.rs`): `SPEND_ARTIFACT_ABILITY`, `SPEND_ELDRAZI_SPELL`, `SPEND_ELDRAZI_ABILITY`,
`SPEND_LAND_ABILITY`, `SPEND_OUTSIDE_HAND`; the IR's `artifact_activation`, `colorless_eldrazi` (two
purposes), `land_activation` and `cast_from_outside_hand` lower to them (`legendary_permanent_ability`,
`not_nonartifact_spell`, `colored_only` stay denied: no Oracle text of the table says them, 160).
What a payment satisfies: casting (`Game::spend_allow_from`: artifact, legendary, colorless Eldrazi
(CR 105.2c, 205.3j), cast from anywhere but the hand, by the cast's `CastFrom`), activating an ability
(`Game::ability_allow`: of an artifact, land or colorless Eldrazi source, as the activation begins:
the activation's payment, its X maximum, `cost_payable`, a mana ability's own cost with priority);
"unless pays" and special actions none. Only purposes the table's mana has are worked out
(`CardDb::spend_kinds`): the cube's payments are unchanged.

*Restricted mana in the pool.* What a payment leaves of restricted mana, or a mana ability activated
with priority adds, keeps its restriction: Mishra's Workshop's artifact-only {C} stays
`ManaPool::art` (layout v5 encodes it), every other kind is `Game::pool_restr` (player, type,
purposes, amount; a part of `ManaPool::amt`, emptied with the pools), and the payment model reads
both as one list of kinds (`Game::pool_kinds`, `set_pool_kinds`): `vgroups` (spendable restricted
mana is the `+16` kind, the rest held), `add_pool` (castability), `pick_multi` (`PayMana::extra_restr`
replaces `extra_art`), `pool_rems` (`Rem::restr`: per spend the greatest restricted amounts, then
`eoe_w2::kinds_left` splits them among the kinds, a kind whose purposes are all another's spent
first; two kinds neither of which covers the other are the player's choice, `PayPool`) and
`finish_payment` (converge's restricted units, the pool written back). The lowering no longer limits
restricted productions to one mana or the Workshop's {C}s (only `{X}` mana and haste mana with a
restriction are denied).

*Found, left for the maintainer (changes cube games).* Mana a mana ability makes with priority (the
source about to be lost, 86.1/86.2) went to the pool unrestricted: Mishra's Workshop's {C}{C}{C} or
Delighted Halfling's mana floated in response could pay anything. Keeping the restriction changes 12
of the 2,500 digest games, so `add_restricted_mana` keeps it only in tables whose mana has a purpose
beyond the cube's two (the EoE table); the cube keeps the old behaviour (a known fault). Halfling's
"can't be countered" rider is lost on floated mana either way (the pool has no such tag).

*Not exact, open.* The mana cost of a mana ability activated within a payment (34.2's needs) is
matched with the payment's units by `mana::fits`, which reads types and `MADE` only: restricted mana
the payment may spend also pays such a need whatever the need's source is (Mishra's Workshop's {C}
pays Chromatic Star's {1} while casting an artifact spell: a cube fault since 34), and restricted mana
the payment may not spend is not offered for a need its restriction allows (Sunken Citadel's
land-ability mana for Cascading Cataracts' {5} while casting a spell). Exact needs a restriction per
unit and an allowance per need in the matching (the masks' eight bits are taken: types, `MADE`,
`RESTRICTED`/`NOT_MADE`); not done.
